defs.def: a liquid food made by boiling meat, vegetables, etc. in water, often eaten as the first course of a meal 汤；羹verb

ex.s: Shanghai Taste offers arguably the best soup dumplings in the area.
ex.t: Shanghai Taste可以说拥有本地区最好吃的汤包。

ex.s: Younger kids might make cookies while older ones are cooking soup and meatballs.
ex.t: 较小的孩子可能做饼干，较大的孩子则煮汤、做肉丸。

ex.s: Xiao long bao (soup dumplings), those amazing constructions of delicate dumpling wrappers, encasing hot, ____36____ (taste) soup and sweet, fresh meat, are far and away my favorite Chinese street food.
ex.t: 小笼包（汤包），那些由精致面皮包裹着的奇妙杰作，里面包着滚烫____36____（taste）的汤汁和香甜鲜嫩的肉馅，绝对是我最喜欢的中国街头小吃。

ex.s: Shanghai may be the ____39____ (recognize) home of the soup dumplings but food historians will actually point you to the neighboring canal town of Nanxiang as Xiao long hao’s birthplace.
ex.t: 上海也许是____39____（recognize）公认的汤包之乡，但食品历史学家实际上会告诉你，邻近的运河小镇南翔才是小笼包的发源地。

ex.s: There you will find them prepared differently- more dumpling and less soup, and the wrappers are pressed ____40____ hand rather than rolled.
ex.t: 在那里，你会发现小笼包的做法不同——馅更多、汤更少，而且面皮是____40____手按压而不是擀出来的。

ex.s: The meat should be fresh with ____43____ touch of sweetness and the soup hot, clear and delicious.
ex.t: 肉要新鲜，带____43____一丝甜味，汤要烫、要清亮、要美味。

ex.s: Some of my friends had signed up to spend time at a soup kitchen, so I did, too.
ex.t: 我的一些朋友报名去施粥所帮忙，所以我也去了。

ex.s: It saddened me to think of how many people there were who didn’t have a place to call home and the only food they got came from a soup kitchen.
ex.t: 想到有那么多人没有家可回，唯一的食物来源就是施粥所，我感到难过。

ex.s: For example, every morning, my dad has to have the bowl of egg soup while I had to eat an apple.
ex.t: 例如，每天早上，爸爸必须喝那碗蛋汤而我必须吃一个苹果。

ex.s: My dad don’t like the soup and I don’t enjoy apples.
ex.t: 爸爸不喜欢那碗汤，我也不喜欢苹果。

ex.s: What does Maria think of the soup?
ex.t: 玛丽亚觉得这汤怎么样？

ex.s: What does Karl say can be added to the soup?
ex.t: 卡尔说可以往汤里加什么？

ex.s: Friendship soup Like any good soup, This won’t fail to make you smile when you’re feeling down.
ex.t: 友谊汤 就像任何一碗好汤，当你情绪低落时，它一定会让你微笑。

ex.s: The fins are used in shark fin soup.
ex.t: 鱼翅被用来制作鱼翅汤。

ex.s: I reached down, expecting rice and vegetables, but instead stuck my hand into a bowl of warm, thick soup.
ex.t: 我伸手向下，以为会是米饭和蔬菜，但手却伸进了一碗温热的浓汤里。

ex.s: Even using a spoon, most of the soup ended up on my shirt.
ex.t: 即使用了勺子，大部分汤还是洒在了我的衬衫上。

ex.s: Nonetheless, a menu for a hungry astronaut can still be varied and balanced, often including soup, prawn sandwiches, as well as fruit yoghurt.
ex.t: 尽管如此，为饥饿的宇航员准备的菜单仍然可以多样化且均衡，通常包括汤、虾三明治以及水果酸奶。
